# Making a change

```sh
pnpm install
docker compose up -d   # Postgres
pnpm dev               # the app on http://localhost:5173
pnpm test              # Vitest
pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck
```

A pull request runs the same checks in CI. Billing changes need a test in cents: `total.test.ts` shows how.
